engine_build_v4.objective: Engine hardening: guard against an all-zero / constant carrier (real-data finding)
engine_build_v4.note: Real VitalDB data exposed it: an identically-zero carrier (e.g. a case with no volatile agent) is not compositional -> log(0) -> nan -> diagnostics.py eigh 'Eigenvalues did not converge'. Harness worked around it by dropping all-zero carriers before the run. RECOMMEND (flagged, NOT patched - Peter's gate): the live engine should detect an all-zero/constant carrier, drop it (or guard the eigh with a jitter/SVD fallback), and emit a CAL/structural diagnostic code instead of producing nan. Live engine only (additive); do not touch the frozen oracle.

HUF-Gov Ratio Blindness doctrine (MC-4 'see or remain blind')
governance_documentation.note: Formalizes Peter's principle: monitoring has 4 categories (MC-1 magnitude, MC-2 identity, MC-3 trend, MC-4 composition); conventional instruments do 1-3 and are blind to the 4th (ratios). Ratio Blindness cost = 1/4 (the whole 4th category undiagnosed) - a category-count heuristic, honestly tiered as NOT a measured 25%. 'Once seen, ratios cannot be ignored.' Evidence: COPD trial (magnitude p>0.05, MC-4 unmasked) + the public gas study (40/60 alarms-green; deceptive window 2.5x). Extends the existing MC-4 instrument claim (HUF/discoveries/instruments/MC4_COMPOSITION_MONITORING.md; 4 defeat paths).

New standing convention: folders that matter carry a small local AI_ASSIST.json node = topic-specific knowledge + a link UP to the central AI-refresh chain (source-of-truth order unchanged; nodes link up, centre never tracks down). Bring-your-own-AI: any agent can self-onboard on a topic from its node, then climb the chain. Distributes knowledge to the edge, reduces central refresh/admin load, keeps one structured control system. Seed nodes: industrial-instruments/AI_ASSIST.json + industrial-instruments/gas-composition-study/AI_ASSIST.json (both valid JSON). From now on, new topic folders get a node.

space_readiness.objective: Real space-biology run: NASA GeneLab GLDS-1 Drosophila spaceflight transcriptome
space_readiness.note: Peter supplied GLDS-1/OSD-1 (GeneLab study #1; Drosophila immune response in spaceflight; Affymetrix). RAN Hs on uninfected GC->FLT (6 samples) over ALL 18,952 probesets: LOSSLESS high-D read 1.2e-13 (a real ~19k-dim transcriptome). HONEST GLOBAL NULL: whole-transcriptome ground-vs-flight Aitchison distance = 0.95x within-group replicate variation -> NO global separation; spaceflight signal is gene-specific not global -> use differential expression (a signature; GeneLab DE table). Same lesson as the Crohn microbiome null + MC-4 (global read is a finding; signal in the specifics; DX-NUL-DIS). Caveat: microarray-as-composition is exploratory (RNA-seq counts cleaner). Ties the space-biology arm to real OSDR data (s3://nasa-osdr/). Derived comp off-repo; raw not copied.
